svg.title: The /ship pipeline
svg.desc: Plan: load config, inventory artifacts, discovery check for new features, classify, plan stages, you approve the plan. Build (step 5): PRD by Product, gate prd-to-rfc, you approve; RFC and API contract by Engineering, gate rfc-to-impl, you approve; implement by Engineering and sub-agents, gate impl-to-qa, you approve. In parallel: launch brief by Growth, threat model by Ops & Risk, test plan by QA. Verify: user docs and tours, seed and verify, QA report, optional dogfood, optional experiment review. Release: release gate with tests, lint, scan, pre-deploy and version bump, gate release, you approve; release summary; optional AI cost logging; what next. At every gate: delegate, validate and link, promote to review, check-gate, you review, then approve or iterate.
svg.text: One command takes a feature from idea to release. It pauses at every gate for your approval.
Build · Step 5, one stage at a time
f. Changes requested: the agent iterates with your feedback
e. Approved: promote.sh marks the artifact approved and the next stage starts.
